findings_addressed.oracle: AnthropicProvider._build_api_kwargs() with enable_cache=True must rewrite kwargs['system'] from a plain string to a list of structured text blocks where the last block carries cache_control={'type':'ephemeral'}, AND the final content block of the last message must also carry cache_control={'type':'ephemeral'}. With enable_cache=False, both locations must remain plain strings with no cache_control key. This is independently derived from the Anthropic prompt-caching specification and verified by inspecting the raw dict returned by the production implementation.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/anthropic.py _build_api_kwargs(), remove or comment out the line 'AnthropicProvider._apply_cache_breakpoints(kwargs, system_prompt=system_prompt)' (making enable_cache=True a no-op). The cache_control key is then absent from both the system block and the last message block, and 'assert last_system_block.get("cache_control") == {"type": "ephemeral"}' fails immediately.

findings_addressed.oracle: After trimming [system, user-A*4000, assistant-B*4000, user-C*4000] with context_window=2000 (budget=1700t), the newest user-C content must survive and older user-A and assistant-B contents must be absent; verified by set membership on trimmed message contents
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/core/orchestrator.py trim_messages_to_context_window(), change 'oldest_idx = next((i for i, m in enumerate(messages) if m.role != "system"), -1)' to use 'enumerate(reversed(messages))' logic that removes newest-first — user-C would be removed and 'assert newer_content in trimmed_contents' fails

findings_addressed.oracle: response.thinking_content is None (no thinking leaked into a non-Anthropic message) and len(response.content) > 0 (real answer was returned); both are independent of any injected value
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/openai.py _build_chat_response() or chat(), set message.thinking_content to a non-None value (e.g. 'leaked') — the 'assert response.thinking_content is None' assertion fails

findings_addressed.oracle: Both True and False must appear in {m.supports_tools for m in models}; independently verified by bidirectional set-membership — a bridge returning all-True fails the False-in check, all-False fails the True-in check
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/openrouter.py _build_model_info(), change 'supports_tools = ...' to always return True — the 'assert False in tool_support_values' assertion fails

notes: G0249 re-hardened 2026-06-21: previous version only checked round-trip completion (role, content, total_tokens) which passes even when enable_cache=True is silently dropped. New gate calls _build_api_kwargs() directly via getattr to bypass reportPrivateUsage, compares cached vs uncached kwargs structurally: with enable_cache=True the system key must be a list with cache_control={type:ephemeral} on the last block, and the last message content must be a block list with the same cache_control; with enable_cache=False both must remain plain strings. This is a pure static structural inspection test requiring no network, no fixture, no mock. The adversarial mutation (removing the _apply_cache_breakpoints call) makes cache_control absent and fails immediately. No src/ files were modified.
